buildCommand: npm run build && node -e "const fs=require('fs');const path=require('path');function cp(s,d){if(!fs.existsSync(d))fs.mkdirSync(d,{recursive:true});for(const f of fs.readdirSync(s)){const sp=path.join(s,f),dp=path.join(d,f);fs.statSync(sp).isDirectory()?cp(sp,dp):fs.copyFileSync(sp,dp)}}cp('Assets','dist/Assets')"
